_comment: Hand corrections to the reader's output for A16A1, in pixels of the
Board boxes for the ICs, the headers and L4 follow the printed body outline,
since the designator sits inside it; the rest are the reader's label boxes,
each looked at on the drawing.
_boardComment: The reader placed 21 of 26 and got 18 right. P1 landed on the 'A91' artwork
legend, U10 on U15's label, and R2 on the E of 'CONTROLLER'. Every position
below was read off scripts/page_grid.py over drawing_full.png.

U15.note: Body outline; the reader had U10 here

U10.note: Body outline; the reader put U10 on U15

U12.note: Body outline; the reader did not find it

P1.note: Header outline; the reader put P1 on the 'A91' legend

P2.note: Header outline; the reader did not find it

Z2.note: Label to the left of the SIP outline; the reader did not find it

drop.R2: The reader found R2 on the E of 'CONTROLLER ASS 775320'. R2 is not printed on the drawing (see notOnDrawing).

_schematicComment: Five sheet positions corrected. The reader put C52 on C2*, C57 on C7*, L4 on
LC1*, P2 on PA2 and U10 on PC3; in each case one of its own alternate reads
was the right label and is used here.

C52.note: 10uF/35V on +5 RLH at the bottom left; the reader chose the C2* net label

C57.note: Decoupling on +5LH above U11; the reader chose the C7* net label

L4.note: 6-turn choke in the +5 RLH feed; the reader chose LC1*

P2.note: The bus-side P2 at the left; the reader chose the PA2 pin label

U10.note: The first 5801, label below its block; the reader chose PC3

sh1.R2: R2 is not drawn on the sheet; the reader put it on RD*

_notOnDrawingComment: MP3 is the unlabelled 10-pin test header and R2 is listed but not printed on
the drawing or drawn on the sheet (see the caveat in a16a1.reference.json).
